profile.role_note: Premier Aero Erosion enabler; also applies Spectro Frazzle in off-element teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Essential enabler for Cartethyia's Aero Erosion team and a good general Aero buffer; pull her if you're investing in Aero, less value otherwise.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Woodland Aria (or Phasic Homogenizer / Static Mist) + 5-piece Gusts of Welkin in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Reminiscence: Fleurdelys in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Aero DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and enough Energy Regen to keep her Liberation cycling.

ranked_weapons.name: Woodland Aria
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. ATK%, Aero DMG on Erosion application, and Aero RES shred. Tailor-made for her.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: 3.0 standard pistol; universal ATK and All-Attribute DMG buffs. A close second.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen plus ATK buff to the incoming Resonator on Outro.

ranked_weapons.name: Lux & Umbra
ranked_weapons.note: Echo Skill / Heavy Attack DMG amplification with DEF ignore when both are active.

ranked_weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% and Tune Shifting team DMG buffs on Basic Attacks.

ranked_weapons.name: The Last Dance
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% and Resonance Skill DMG; usable stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Romance in Farewell
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable F2P option; ATK buff on hitting enemies with Negative Statuses.

ranked_weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
ranked_weapons.note: Resonance Energy and ATK after casting skill; decent 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Cadenza
ranked_weapons.note: Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill; budget rotation smoother.

echo_sets.name: Gusts of Welkin
echo_sets.note: Tailor-made for her: inflicting Aero Erosion grants 15% Aero DMG to the whole team (30% for her). Fleurdelys is the set's only 4-cost echo.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Best set when she's in Spectro Frazzle teams; ATK and DMG buffs for the next Resonator plus Energy Regen.

echo_sets.name: Gusts of Welkin + Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: Early-game placeholder; buffs only Ciaccona herself.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit; her own damage is non-negligible.

build.energy_regen_target: not published by Game8; community guides suggest ~150%

teams.name: Premium: Cartethyia + Ciaccona + Chisa

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: Aero Erosion hypercarry; reliant on Ciaccona's stacks and buffs at S0.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: The Erosion enabler: stacks, Aero buffs, and team-wide Aero DMG from Gusts of Welkin.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Raises the Erosion stack cap and reduces enemy DEF with Havoc Bane.

teams.rotation: Chisa opens with her Forte combo, Ciaccona applies Erosion and team buffs, then Cartethyia stacks Erosion and transforms into Fleurdelys for the burst.

teams.name: Alternative: Jiyan + Ciaccona + Verina

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: Launch-era Aero AoE carry; benefits from Ciaccona's general Aero DMG buffs.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Works as a general Aero DMG buffer for DPS units like Jiyan and Sigrika, per Game8.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer and buffer; her Outro deepens all-type DMG.

teams.rotation: Verina keeps the team healthy and buffed, Ciaccona quick-swaps in to apply Erosion and drop her Outro, then Jiyan takes an extended AoE on-field window.

tier_badge.label: Excellent
tier_badge.note: Essential Aero Erosion enabler; her support value keeps her high.

sequences.verdict: S0 handles her whole support role. S2 adds 40% team Aero DMG — the one dupe worth chasing; S6 for whales.

pull_path.why: Full Aero Erosion support kit with no dupes needed.
+35% ATK on Basic and interrupt immunity — the F2P-friendly dupe (ldshop).
Liberation grants the team +40% Aero DMG — the one dupe worth chasing (game8, ldshop).
Solo Concert strikes for 220% ATK as Liberation DMG.

nodes.name: Where Wind Sings
nodes.effect: Skill grants 3s interrupt immunity; Basic Attacks grant +35% ATK for 10s.

nodes.name: Song of the Four Seasons
nodes.effect: During Liberation, the team gains +40% Aero DMG Bonus.

nodes.name: Starlit Improv
nodes.effect: Basic Attack Stage 4 grants +1 Musical Essence; Harmonic Allegro +1 charge.

nodes.name: Toccata and Fugue
nodes.effect: Quadruple Downbeat and Liberation DMG ignore 45% DEF.

nodes.name: Eternal Idyll to Lasting Summer
nodes.effect: +40% Liberation DMG; team in Liberation range takes 30% less DMG.

nodes.name: Unending Cadence
nodes.effect: Solo Concert: 220% ATK Aero DMG to nearby targets, considered Liberation DMG.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Woodland Aria is a strong personal upgrade but optional — S0 is complete and S2 adds the team value; skip the weapon if pulls are tight (gurugamer).
